answer: At dawn, a periodic challenge requires solving a unique proof tied to that key; forged identities cannot reuse it. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a hardware root key and post a slow-decaying reputation earned across epochs. Sybils must fund and maintain many costly bonds, and crossing the bridge from fresh keys to trusted standing demands repeated verified work, raising attacker cost above any reward. Basalt-anchored audit logs make duplicate identities detectable. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
